Campus Tour Guide - Student Position
Office of Admissions, Bellmont College

Lead walking tours of campus for prospective students and their families.
Answer questions about academics, housing, and student life with honesty and warmth.
Must be a current Bellmont student in good academic standing.
Must be available for at least two tour shifts per week during the semester.
Public speaking experience is a plus.
Experience with social media content creation is preferred.
You will be responsible for checking in tour groups and recording attendance in a spreadsheet.
Help staff the welcome desk during open house events.
Spanish or another second language would be helpful.
Apply by October 1 through the student jobs portal.
